title: Verify Administrator can change a work order line status (approve, decline, complete)
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has Work Order Lines: Create and Edit plus Full View).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Open a work order and locate a line.
2. Change the line status to Approved.
3. Change the line status to Declined.
4. Change the line status to Complete.
expected: Each status change (Approve, Decline, Complete) is available and saves successfully. The line shows its new status after each change.
